subject: general
question: The ______ aims to provide tap water connection to every rural home by 2024.
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Jal Jeevan Mission.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jal Jeevan Mission** is envisioned to provide safe and adequate drinking water through individual household tap connections by **2024 **to all households in rural India.
 
• The programme will also implement source sustainability measures as mandatory elements, such as recharge and reuse through grey water management, water conservation, rain water harvesting.
 
• The Jal Jeevan Mission will be based on a community approach to water and will include extensive information, education, and communication as a key component of the mission. 
 
• It is a flagship programme of the Government of India, launched by Hon'ble Prime Minister on **15th August 2019**.
 
• It will be implemented over 5__ years, with an outlay of Rs 2,87,000 crore.
 
• The government has set aside 50,000 crore rupees for drinking water and ten thousand crore rupees for sanitation.
 
• The budget allocation for Jal Jeevan Mission increased by 450% for 2021.
